if (!IsTwoD) begin : gen_one_d
    /*
     * DMA Frontend
     */
    idma_reg64_frontend #(
      .ObserverPort ( ObserverPort ),
      .BatchPort ( BatchPort ),
      .dma_regs_req_t  ( dma_regs_req_t ),
      .dma_regs_rsp_t  ( dma_regs_rsp_t ),
      .burst_req_t     ( idma_req_t     ),
      .DEVICE_ID       ( DEVICE_ID      ),
      .PROCESS_ID      ( PROCESS_ID     ),
      .AxiIdWidth      ( AxiIdWidth     ),
      .AxID            ( AxID           )
    ) i_dma_frontend (
      .obs_issue_o, .obs_done_o, .obs_poll_o, .batch_active_o,
      .obs_issue_id_o, .obs_done_id_o, .obs_poll_id_o,
      .obs_cfg_valid_o, .obs_cfg_write_o, .obs_cfg_addr_o,
      .obs_cfg_wdata_o, .obs_cfg_wstrb_o, .obs_cfg_rdata_i,
      .clk_i,
      .rst_ni,
      // AXI slave: control port
      .dma_ctrl_req_i   ( dma_regs_req      ),
      .dma_ctrl_rsp_o   ( dma_regs_rsp      ),
      // Backend control
      .burst_req_o      ( burst_req_d       ),
      .valid_o          ( be_valid_d        ),
      .ready_i          ( be_ready_d        ),
      .backend_idle_i   ( ~|idma_busy       ),
      .trans_complete_i ( be_trans_complete ),

      .ttype_o          ( ttype             ),
      .wdata_o          ( wdata             ),
      .rdata_i          ( rdata             ),
      .rdata_valid_i    ( rdata_valid       )
    );

    stream_fifo #(
        .FALL_THROUGH ( 1'b0         ),
        .DATA_WIDTH   ( AxiDataWidth ),
        .DEPTH        ( JobFifoDepth ),
        .T            ( idma_req_t   )
      ) i_stream_fifo_jobs_oned (
        .clk_i,
        .rst_ni,
        .testmode_i,
        .flush_i    ( 1'b0                ),
        .usage_o    ( /* NOT CONNECTED */ ),
        .data_i     ( burst_req_d         ),
        .valid_i    ( be_valid_d          ),
        .ready_o    ( be_ready_d          ),
        .data_o     ( burst_req           ),
        .valid_o    ( be_valid            ),
        .ready_i    ( be_ready            )
    );


    assign be_trans_complete = idma_rsp_valid;
    assign idma_rsp_ready    = 1'b1;

idma_backend #(
    .DataWidth           ( AxiDataWidth                ),
    .AddrWidth           ( AxiAddrWidth                ),
    .UserWidth           ( AxiUserWidth                ),
    .AxiIdWidth          ( AxiIdWidth                  ),
    .NumAxInFlight       ( NumAxInFlight               ),
    .BufferDepth         ( BufferDepth                 ),
    .TFLenWidth          ( TFLenWidth                  ),
    .RAWCouplingAvail    ( RAWCouplingAvail            ),
    .MaskInvalidData     ( 1'b0                        ),
    .HardwareLegalizer   ( 1'b1                        ),
    .RejectZeroTransfers ( 1'b1                        ),
    .MemSysDepth         ( MemSysDepth                 ),
    .ErrorCap            ( idma_pkg::NO_ERROR_HANDLING ),
    .idma_req_t          ( idma_req_t                  ),
    .idma_rsp_t          ( idma_rsp_t                  ),
    .idma_eh_req_t       ( idma_pkg::idma_eh_req_t     ),
    .idma_busy_t         ( idma_pkg::idma_busy_t       ),
    .protocol_req_t      ( axi_mst_req_t               ),
    .protocol_rsp_t      ( axi_mst_rsp_t               ),
    .aw_chan_t           ( axi_mst_aw_chan_t           ),

// Datapath decoupling
    //--------------------------------------
    idma_stream_fifo #(
        .Depth        ( NumAxInFlight ),
        .type_t       ( r_dp_req_t    ),
        .PrintInfo    ( PrintFifoInfo )
    ) i_r_dp_req (
        .clk_i,
        .rst_ni,
        .testmode_i,
        .flush_i   ( 1'b0                ),
        .usage_o   ( /* NOT CONNECTED */ ),
        .data_i    ( r_req.r_dp_req      ),
        .valid_i   ( r_valid             ),
        .ready_o   ( r_dp_req_in_ready   ),
        .data_o    ( r_dp_req_out        ),
        .valid_o   ( r_dp_req_out_valid  ),

if (1'b1) begin : gen_last_flag_fifo
        idma_stream_fifo #(
            .Depth        ( MetaFifoDepth ),
            .type_t       ( logic [1:0]   ),
            .PrintInfo    ( PrintFifoInfo )
        ) i_w_last (
            .clk_i,
            .rst_ni,
            .testmode_i,
            .flush_i   ( 1'b0                            ),
            .usage_o   ( /* NOT CONNECTED */             ),
            .data_i    ( {w_req.super_last, w_req.last}  ),
            .valid_i   ( w_valid & w_ready               ),
            .ready_o   ( w_last_ready                    ),
            .data_o    ( {w_super_last, w_last_burst}    ),
            .valid_o   ( /* NOT CONNECTED */             ),
            .ready_i   ( w_dp_rsp_valid & w_dp_rsp_ready )
        );

logic [NumDMADevices-1:0] obs_rlast, obs_b, obs_bad_id;
        for (genvar o = 0; o < NumDMADevices; o++) begin : gen_dma_observation
            assign obs_arvalid[o] = axi_dma_tr_req[o].ar_valid;
            assign obs_awvalid[o] = axi_dma_tr_req[o].aw_valid;
            assign obs_arready[o] = axi_dma_tr_resp[o].ar_ready;
            assign obs_awready[o] = axi_dma_tr_resp[o].aw_ready;
            assign obs_rlast[o] = axi_dma_tr_resp[o].r_valid && axi_dma_tr_resp[o].r.last && axi_dma_tr_req[o].r_ready;
            assign obs_b[o] = axi_dma_tr_resp[o].b_valid && axi_dma_tr_req[o].b_ready;
            // Each current iDMA emits AxID=0. Monitor its private mux-side ID.
            assign obs_bad_id[o] = (obs_arvalid[o] && |axi_dma_tr_req[o].ar.id) ||
                (obs_awvalid[o] && |axi_dma_tr_req[o].aw.id) ||
                (axi_dma_tr_resp[o].r_valid && |axi_dma_tr_resp[o].r.id) ||
                (axi_dma_tr_resp[o].b_valid && |axi_dma_tr_resp[o].b.id);
        end
        dma_observer #(.NumPorts(NumDMADevices), .PathEnable(InclIOMMU),
                       .AxiIdWidth(ariane_soc::IdWidth)) i_dma_observer (
            .clk_i, .rst_ni,
            .cfg_valid_i(obs_cfg_valid[0]), .cfg_write_i(obs_cfg_write[0]),
            .cfg_addr_i(obs_cfg_addr[0]), .cfg_wdata_i(obs_cfg_wdata[0]),
            .cfg_wstrb_i(obs_cfg_wstrb[0]), .cfg_rdata_o(obs_cfg_rdata),
            .issue_i(obs_issue), .done_i(obs_done), .poll_i(obs_poll),
            .batch_active_i(batch_active),
            .issue_id_i(obs_issue_id), .done_id_i(obs_done_id), .poll_id_i(obs_poll_id),
            .ar_valid_i(obs_arvalid), .aw_valid_i(obs_awvalid),
            .ar_ready_i(obs_arready), .aw_ready_i(obs_awready),
            .rlast_fire_i(obs_rlast), .b_fire_i(obs_b), .bad_id_i(obs_bad_id),
            .shared_ar_valid_i(axi_iommu_tr_req.ar_valid),
            .shared_aw_valid_i(axi_iommu_tr_req.aw_valid),
            .shared_ar_ready_i(axi_iommu_tr_resp.ar_ready),
            .shared_aw_ready_i(axi_iommu_tr_resp.aw_ready),
            .tr_id_i('{axi_iommu_tr_req.ar.id, axi_iommu_tr_req.aw.id}),
            .out_id_i('{axi_iommu_comp_req.ar.id, axi_iommu_comp_req.aw.id}),
            .return_id_i('{axi_iommu_comp_resp.r.id, axi_iommu_comp_resp.b.id}),
            .out_valid_i({axi_iommu_comp_req.aw_valid, axi_iommu_comp_req.ar_valid}),
            .out_ready_i({axi_iommu_comp_resp.aw_ready, axi_iommu_comp_resp.ar_ready}),
            .return_i({axi_iommu_comp_resp.b_valid && axi_iommu_comp_req.b_ready,
                       axi_iommu_comp_resp.r_valid && axi_iommu_comp_resp.r.last && axi_iommu_comp_req.r_ready})
        );

axi_mux #(
            .SlvAxiIDWidth ( DmaAxiIdWidth        ),
            .slv_aw_chan_t ( axi_dma_tr_aw_chan_t ),
            .mst_aw_chan_t ( axi_tr_aw_chan_t     ),
            .w_chan_t      ( axi_dma_tr_w_chan_t  ),
            .slv_b_chan_t  ( axi_dma_tr_b_chan_t  ),
            .mst_b_chan_t  ( axi_tr_b_chan_t      ),
            .slv_ar_chan_t ( axi_dma_tr_ar_chan_t ),
            .mst_ar_chan_t ( axi_tr_ar_chan_t     ),
            .slv_r_chan_t  ( axi_dma_tr_r_chan_t  ),
            .mst_r_chan_t  ( axi_tr_r_chan_t      ),
            .slv_req_t     ( axi_dma_tr_req_t     ),
            .slv_resp_t    ( axi_dma_tr_resp_t    ),
            .mst_req_t     ( axi_tr_req_t         ),
            .mst_resp_t    ( axi_tr_resp_t        ),
            .NoSlvPorts    ( NumDMADevices        ),
            .MaxWTrans     ( 8                    )
        ) i_dma_iommu_tr_mux (
            .clk_i,
            .rst_ni,
            .test_i      ( 1'b0              ),
            .slv_reqs_i  ( axi_dma_tr_req    ),
            .slv_resps_o ( axi_dma_tr_resp   ),
            .mst_req_o   ( axi_iommu_tr_req  ),
            .mst_resp_i  ( axi_iommu_tr_resp )

.AXI_USER_WIDTH     ( AxiUserWidth             ),
                .JOB_FIFO_DEPTH     ( 8                        ),
                .NUM_AX_IN_FLIGHT   ( 8                        ),
                .MEM_SYS_DEPTH      ( 0                        ),
                .RAW_COUPLING_AVAIL ( 0                        ),
                .IS_TWO_D           ( 0                        ),
                .BATCH_PORT (1'b1),
                .OBSERVER_PORT      ( i == 0                   ),

                .DEVICE_ID          ( 24'(10 + i)              ),
                .PROCESS_ID         ( 20'(20 + i)              ),

end else begin : gen_ds_direct
            `AXI_ASSIGN_FROM_REQ(iommu_ds, axi_iommu_ds_req)
            `AXI_ASSIGN_TO_RESP(axi_iommu_ds_resp, iommu_ds)
        end

        // AXI Bus between IOMMU Completion IF and System Interconnect
        `AXI_ASSIGN_FROM_REQ(iommu_comp, axi_iommu_comp_req)
        `AXI_ASSIGN_TO_RESP(axi_iommu_comp_resp, iommu_comp)

localparam axi_pkg::xbar_cfg_t AXI_XBAR_CFG = '{
  NoSlvPorts:         ariane_soc::NrSlaves,
  NoMstPorts:         ariane_soc::NB_PERIPHERALS,
  MaxMstTrans:        8, // Modified to 8
  MaxSlvTrans:        8, // Modified to 8
  FallThrough:        1'b0,
  LatencyMode:        axi_pkg::CUT_ALL_PORTS,
  PipelineStages:     32'd1,
  AxiIdWidthSlvPorts: AxiIdWidthMaster,
  AxiIdUsedSlvPorts:  AxiIdWidthMaster,
  UniqueIds:          1'b0,
  AxiAddrWidth:       AxiAddrWidth,
  AxiDataWidth:       AxiDataWidth,
  NoAddrRules:        ariane_soc::NB_PERIPHERALS
};

axi_xbar_intf #(
  .AXI_USER_WIDTH ( AxiUserWidth            ),
  .Cfg            ( AXI_XBAR_CFG            ),
  .rule_t         ( axi_pkg::xbar_rule_64_t )
) i_axi_xbar (
  .clk_i                 ( clk        ),
  .rst_ni                ( ndmreset_n ),
  .test_i                ( test_en    ),

spill_register #(
      .T       ( mst_b_chan_t ),
      .Bypass  ( ~SpillB      )
    ) i_b_spill_reg (
      .clk_i   ( clk_i                      ),
      .rst_ni  ( rst_ni                     ),
      .valid_i ( mst_resp_i.b_valid         ),
      .ready_o ( mst_req_o.b_ready          ),
      .data_i  ( mst_resp_i.b               ),
      .valid_o ( mst_b_valid                ),
      .ready_i ( slv_b_readies[switch_b_id] ),
      .data_o  ( mst_b_chan                 )
    );

    //--------------------------------------

spill_register #(
      .T       ( mst_r_chan_t ),
      .Bypass  ( ~SpillR      )
    ) i_r_spill_reg (
      .clk_i   ( clk_i                      ),
      .rst_ni  ( rst_ni                     ),
      .valid_i ( mst_resp_i.r_valid         ),
      .ready_o ( mst_req_o.r_ready          ),
      .data_i  ( mst_resp_i.r               ),
      .valid_o ( mst_r_valid                ),
      .ready_i ( slv_r_readies[switch_r_id] ),
      .data_o  ( mst_r_chan                 )
    );
  end

// pragma translate_off

stream_fifo #(
        .DEPTH(RVIOMMUCfg.NumOutstandingTrans),
        .T    (axi_tr_aw_chan_t)
    ) i_aw_stream_fifo (
        .clk_i      (clk_i),
        .rst_ni     (rst_ni),

        .flush_i    ('0),
        .testmode_i ('0),
        .usage_o    (  ),

        .data_i     (tr_axi_req_i.aw),
        .valid_i    (tr_axi_req_i.aw_valid),
        .ready_o    (tr_aw_ready),

        .data_o     (aw_data),
        .valid_o    (aw_valid),
        .ready_i    (aw_ready)
    );

    axi_tr_ar_chan_t ar_data;
    logic ar_valid;
    logic ar_ready;
    logic tr_ar_ready;

    stream_fifo #(
        .DEPTH(RVIOMMUCfg.NumOutstandingTrans),
        .T    (axi_tr_ar_chan_t)
    ) i_ar_stream_fifo (
        .clk_i      (clk_i),
        .rst_ni     (rst_ni),

        .flush_i    ('0),
        .testmode_i ('0),
        .usage_o    (  ),

        .data_i     (tr_axi_req_i.ar),
        .valid_i    (tr_axi_req_i.ar_valid),
        .ready_o    (tr_ar_ready),

        .data_o     (ar_data),
        .valid_o    (ar_valid),
        .ready_i    (ar_ready)
    );

/* Free memory management - zoned buddy allocator.  */
#ifndef CONFIG_ARCH_FORCE_MAX_ORDER
#define MAX_ORDER 10
#else
#define MAX_ORDER CONFIG_ARCH_FORCE_MAX_ORDER
#endif
#define MAX_ORDER_NR_PAGES (1 << MAX_ORDER)

# CONFIG_KSM is not set
CONFIG_DEFAULT_MMAP_MIN_ADDR=4096
CONFIG_ARCH_WANTS_THP_SWAP=y
# CONFIG_TRANSPARENT_HUGEPAGE is not set
# CONFIG_CMA is not set
CONFIG_GENERIC_EARLY_IOREMAP=y
# CONFIG_DEFERRED_STRUCT_PAGE_INIT is not set
# CONFIG_IDLE_PAGE_TRACKING is not set
